rationale: Independent inspection of the attached source pages supports the translation's algebraic setting, hyperbolicity assumption, initial half-line data, and spectral wave structure. No definite substantive mismatch is established. Acceptance is nevertheless premature because the blind translation itself leaves the measure underlying its central solution predicate unresolved. Adjudication should identify that dependency and then determine whether the explicit construction and boundary conventions yield the source's integral solution, and whether the additional assertions are equivalent refinements or genuine strengthening.
